svg.text: Every Monster irrep as a group of spinning polygons of different degrees
each active Ogg prime column j → one regular polygon of degree 3+j (triangle for 2 … 17-gon for 71), nested and spun at its own rate
all 194 irreps overlaid in groups · colours: 2 cyan · 3 magenta · 5 amber · 7 green · 11 orange · 13 violet · … · 71 white (irrepRows_length = 194)
